title: The ABC conjecture
notes: Slides dated 12 September 2013, read on 22 September 2026. Page 26 states the Masser-Oesterle conjecture: for each epsilon>0, all but finitely many coprime positive A+B=C satisfy C<rad(ABC)^(1+epsilon), equivalently a bound with an epsilon-dependent constant for all triples. Used only as an explicit hypothesis in docs/problems/juggler_power_family_reentry.md. The square-reentry consequence and its gcd normalization are derived in that dossier; this source does not claim a Juggler result. No proof or present-day resolution of abc is imported.
